quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Robert Jenefsky, president and co-founder, is the strongest leadership entry point. Guillaume Teboul was explicitly identified by the organizer as committee treasurer on 22 September 2025; reconfirm his remit. Michael Kuszla is a co-founder and committee member who moderated the reported summer 2026 event. These are relevant relationship/approval conversations, not verified hotel-contract signatories. The public association inbox is info@nyonbusinessforum.ch.
findings.futureEdition: No officially dated next meeting was located for 7 December 2026–30 June 2028 as of 16 November 2026. The latest dated forward announcement found was for Friday 6 November 2026, 12:00–14:00, now past; its venue was not stated. The website agenda includes day/month entries without years, including 6 December, and cannot establish an upcoming edition. Future dates, venue, city and region remain unverified.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied YOTEL specification: a small meeting room plus lunch, workshop or rooftop networking format is credible within the La Côte territory. Historical published scale is more than 20 members on the Gland visit and nearly 50 people at the summer apéritif, not a future attendance guarantee. This supports modest F&B/day-meeting potential, not a 20–120-room block or use of the full 237-room hotel. Founex is not central Nyon: willingness to travel must be tested. Neither a resort stay nor overnight lodging need is evidenced.
findings.venueCommitments: No future venue commitment verified. Historical locations include Base Nyon (25 May 2018 networking talk/lunch), Auberge de la Croix-Blanche, Gingins (16 November 2022 AGM anniversary dinner), Garage Guex, Route d’Oulteret 44, Nyon (5 December 2025), École-club Migros, Chemin de Crève-Coeur 1, Nyon (12 February 2026), and STACK Infrastructure campus, Gland (6 March 2026). These are Nyon/La Côte locations, not downtown Geneva or Lausanne; none proves available future inventory.
findings.historicalRotation: The evidence shows a local multi-venue programme rather than a destination-rotation congress: hotel rooftop/networking, restaurant AGM dinner, company visits, cooking workshop and summer apéritif. The June 2026 retrospective says the summer apéritif was held “une nouvelle fois chez Ex Machina”; its exact activity date is not supplied. Do not convert post dates into event dates.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown. No edition-specific housing bureau, accommodation RFP, room block, room-night figure or lodging booking pathway was found in the reviewed organizer materials. Published meeting registration is through the association: “Insrivez-vous à la séance de votre choix pour CHF 40.-, incluant le lunch et l’activité mentionnée.” The association describes meetings “autour d’un repas léger entre 12h00 et 14h00.” Historical hotel venues identified are Base Nyon and Auberge de la Croix-Blanche, Gingins; neither source establishes an accommodation allocation. Base Vevey is mentioned only as background to the 2018 speaker’s hotel concept, not as an NBF host or block.
findings.organizationStructure: Self-described non-profit, non-political, non-denominational Nyon-area association, founded in October 2017. Its committee organizes the programme throughout the year. No external PCO, DMC, agency or housing operator was identified. Event owner/organizer is the association; visited companies and historical venues are not thereby buyers.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The established format includes member/company-hosted activities and a light lunch; historical public non-member pricing is CHF 40 including lunch and activity, not a disclosed venue budget. Garage Guex provided the announced raclette, and Ex Machina hosted a repeat summer apéritif. A paid hotel proposal must justify value against those formats. No sourced venue-capacity shortfall, hotel sell-out, overflow requirement or room-block displacement was found.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Send a concise hosting introduction to info@nyonbusinessforum.ch for Robert Jenefsky, requesting a discussion with the programme committee and Guillaume Teboul. Offer a site visit and a right-sized meeting/lunch or rooftop networking concept, not an accommodation allotment. Ask for the actual 2027 programme, whether external venue proposals are accepted, attendance, per-person spend, Founex travel acceptance and who approves venue/F&B purchases. Quote only after a specific date and brief are confirmed.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: No confirmed future edition within the requested horizon can currently be approached as an open booking. The 6 November 2026 meeting is past and has no stated venue. Public access to individual sessions and the association inbox provide relationship access, not proof that sourcing is open.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Plausible recurring local day-meeting/F&B capture, explicitly an inference rather than a confirmed opportunity. The organizer verifies monthly activity, and recent examples show small local formats. Seek one trial lunch, workshop or networking visit in Founex; no announced 2027/2028 edition, open tender or lodging demand was established.
